name_cn: 吴江市鹏诺纺织有限公司
main_products: Polyester and nylon woven fabrics: taffeta, oxford, peach skin, suede, spandex stretch, recycled fabrics
woven_evidence: Its listed lines (taffeta, oxford, peach skin and suede) are woven filament fabrics typical of Shengze.

canton_fair.evidence_note: A China Textile News report on the Shengze delegation (56 companies) at the 139th Canton Fair names 吴江鹏诺纺织有限公司.

notes: Its registered business scope includes knitted textiles, and its addresses differ across sources. It claims a 30-mu site, 80M m a year of capacity and a branch in Bangladesh. Layer 2 should check for a knit line and whether it has its own looms.
